## Correct combine formula

For a query row, each rank $r$ computes a partial attention output and a
log-sum-exp over the blocks it owns:

$$
o_r = \frac{\sum_{i \in S_r} s_i v_i}{\sum_{i \in S_r} e^{s_i}}, \qquad
\ell_r = \log \sum_{i \in S_r} e^{s_i}
$$

where $s_i$ are the (max-subtracted) logits and $v_i$ the value vectors. To
combine across ranks you first merge the normalizers with the standard
log-sum-exp reduction:

$$
\ell = \log \sum_r e^{\ell_r}
= m + \log \sum_r e^{\ell_r - m}, \qquad
m = \max_r \ell_r .
$$

The merged output is the log-normalizer-weighted average of the per-rank
outputs:

$$
o = \frac{\sum_r e^{\ell_r} o_r}{\sum_r e^{\ell_r}}
= \sum_r \mathrm{softmax}(\ell_r - m)\, o_r .
$$
